rows.ARS:
Dark red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEIvestal, Victor Hugo ® (hybrid tea, Meilland, 1985)
Exhibition name: Senator Burda ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Marie-Louise (Louisette) Meilland (Paolino) (1920-1987) (France, 1985).
Introduced in France by Meilland et Cie as 'Senator Burda'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. (Rouge groseille). Strong fragrance. 26 petals. Large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
